name: ai-native-sdlc-eval-suite
description: Continuous evaluation benchmarks for AI-Native SDLC compliance, Graphify memory retention, and artifact conformance.

evaluations.name: Artifact Gate Conformance
evaluations.description: Validates that non-trivial changes produce intent.md, spec.md, and implementation_plan.md before modifying code.

evaluations.name: Graphify Regression & Error Memory Check
evaluations.description: Validates that high-risk subsystem modifications query Graphify shortest_path and past incident nodes before editing.

evaluations.name: Context7 Documentation Freshness
evaluations.description: Validates that third-party library calls resolve library IDs and query live official docs rather than guessing parameters.

evaluations.name: Zero Silent Failure Rate
evaluations.description: Validates that error handlers fail fast with explicit exceptions and do not swallow fatal failures.
